tasks.hypothesis_or_question: Can one frozen Rust runner/checker express and police the campaign without duplicating the existing physics?

method: Read main plan and CHECKER.md.
Own new zapote-harness campaign adapter/bin/tests and minimal registration. Reuse zapote-erc public kernels.
Validate strict input/output schemas, bounded true-RMS power solve, exact case census and semantic evidence binding.

tasks.stop_rule: Stop fan-out on any missing enforcement or changed historical behavior. Four-hour checkpoint budget; incomplete work stays incomplete.

tasks.hypothesis_or_question: What changes at 30000 Hz when effective L*f is held at the baseline value?

allowed_change.fixed: C7/UCC27624, nominal 12 V/4.7 ohm, 400 V bus; frozen C1 power/current contract

method: Freeze exact config before solving.
Use the common case grid and recompute waveform moments, operating-domain validity and current-limit derating.
Separate ideal effective-L screen from sourced physical magnetic design.
Report partial losses, ripple, peaks, stored energy and source gaps.
Compare with the frozen F129/control, preserving all failed cases.
tasks.required_specific_deliverable: Complete per-case evidence plus frequency/L table; no whole-assembly rank without complete ledger.
tasks.stop_rule: If model domain or source transfer is unsupported, preserve case as INDETERMINATE; do not silently alter L or load to obtain PASS.

tasks.hypothesis_or_question: Can a physical choke supply approximately 357.528 uH effective at operating bias without erasing the proposed switching benefit?

allowed_change.baseline: Wurth 760800301; source ratings are not inherited by alternatives

method: Inspect up to three exact catalog/custom-vendor candidates from primary magnetic sources.
Capture L versus bias/temperature, tolerance, saturation definition, thermal current conditions, DCR, core/winding loss applicability, dimensions and price/availability timestamp.
Evaluate the common waveform envelope, keeping RMS heating and peak saturation separate.
If no complete catalog option is found, provide a vendor/custom winding requirement with unknowns; do not design a core from invented material data.
tasks.required_specific_deliverable: Up to three source-bound magnetic records, physical-volume envelope and exact missing curves; size/thermal/cost comparison if supported.
tasks.stop_rule: Stop after three candidates/eight sources or deadline; a failed search is not proof no part exists.

tasks.hypothesis_or_question: Do two individually promising compatible changes retain their benefit when combined?
tasks.allowed_change: Coordinator selects exactly two binary design changes and freezes baseline/A/B/A+B; same external contract.
method: Do not select your own favorable combination.
Run all four combinations at three full-load line points; matched power or explicitly derated groups.
Carry source/magnetic/driver applicability and uncertainty through each combined case.
Compute interaction delta = loss(A+B)-loss(A)-loss(B)+loss(base) only for the same complete accounting scope.
If totals are incomplete, report interaction of the named subtotal only.
tasks.required_specific_deliverable: Twelve declared operating cases plus controls/refinements within budget; interaction table with applicability.
tasks.stop_rule: Do not add isolated wattage savings; unsupported combinations remain gaps.

tasks.hypothesis_or_question: Can an independently prepared control/finalist comparison reproduce the claim and survive source/physics review?
tasks.allowed_change: No design changes; up to three finalists plus baseline frozen by coordinator.
method: Reconstruct inputs from primary source bytes without copying workers summary values.
Use independent analytical/solver anchors where applicable, identifying any shared equations/libraries or missing physical oracle.
Replay full retained results; independently evaluate nominal and worst-stress cases for each finalist.
Reveal the coordinator-sealed verification inputs frozen before optimization, verify their hashes and evaluate them within the invocation budget; no post-result tuning.
Check lost/failed cases, fair power contract, dominant unknowns and topology coverage.
Keep physical qualification open without separately authorized hardware evidence.
tasks.required_specific_deliverable: Coordinator-facing independent acceptance/rejection/gap receipt for every finalist and baseline, with exact discrepancies.
tasks.stop_rule: Shared-model agreement is not independent physics validation. A common defect quarantines all affected tasks, not just this finalist.
